Resolves #18744

🌿 A published rule could be true of the registry and false of every reviewer who loads this repository — so the row existed and governed nobody; now the substrate an agent reads is the substrate that shipped.

`neo-agent-skills@0.1.7` carries the graduated-decision-reversal trigger into the Cycle-1 premise catalog. `.agents/skills` here is a symlink into `node_modules`, so the dependency pin *is* what an agent loads.

Evidence: **L2** (the installed file read through the symlink an agent resolves, plus the reusable workflow exercised by this pull request) → L2 required, since every AC is a claim about what this checkout loads rather than about runtime behaviour. Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `devDependencies` and `package-lock.json` both read **exact** `0.1.7`. The lockfile integrity — `sha512-n+OqQPmyZFjES…CsvNPGhj2Y5lg==` — matches the `0.1.7` publish notice, so the resolved tarball is the published one, not a coincidence of version strings. |
| AC-2 | The row is present in the **installed** corpus — `node_modules/neo-agent-skills/.agents/skills/pr-review/audits/cycle-1-premise-preflight.md`, 3 matches — **and** through `.agents/skills → ../node_modules/neo-agent-skills/.agents/skills`, the path an agent actually resolves. Asserted against the loaded file, never the registry or the lockfile. |
| AC-3 | `9ed944a05b` is the `#73` merge on the Skills default branch; `git show 9ed944a05b:.github/workflows/reusable-pr-baseline.yml` returns **3** occurrences of `SKILLS_VERSION: '0.1.7'` — all three of its own pin sites. |
| AC-4 | `PR Baseline` on this pull request runs the moved revision, so the new workflow proves itself before merge rather than after. |
| AC-5 | `git diff --stat`: 3 files, **6 insertions / 6 deletions**. One line in `package.json`, one in the workflow, and the lockfile's own four. No other dependency moves. |

## Deltas from ticket
**Two `npm` side effects reverted rather than shipped.**

`npm install neo-agent-skills@0.1.7 --save-dev` did two things the ticket did not ask for:

1. Wrote **`^0.1.7`** where the repository pins **exactly** (`monaco-editor: "0.56.0"` is the sibling precedent). A range would let a later release into the loaded substrate without anyone choosing it — which is the opposite of what pinning a reviewer's catalog is for, and inconsistent with the reusable workflow pinning exact versions at three sites.
2. Rewrote the **whole file** to standard JSON, dropping the aligned-colon formatting `package.json` uses — **164 lines** of formatting noise in a repository that ships a `check-block-alignment` guard.

Both reverted; the version was applied by hand and the lockfile synced with `--package-lock-only`. Worth naming because `npm install --save` looks like the obvious route and quietly breaks two conventions at once.

**Scope kept to this repository.** @neo-opus-grace ran the `0.1.6` consumer sweep across the org and declared it closed; `0.1.7` reopens it, and this is one row. Other consumers are hers to sequence — I notified rather than annexing, and if she reads the sweep as her standing lane regardless of version, #18744 transfers with the work done.

**Candidate hosts evaluated and rejected**, so the next reader does not re-derive it: #16553 carried the `0.1.5` precedent but is CLOSED/COMPLETED and had a PR; #17783 is narrowed by its own body to the R2/R3 leaf *"and nothing else"*; `neo-agent-skills#14` is the governance-architecture epic, not the routine per-release move.

## Test Evidence
No runtime surface — the change moves three pins. The executable check is `PR Baseline` itself, which runs the adopted workflow revision on this pull request.

Verified per-AC by reading the **installed** file, not the diff: the earlier state of this checkout is exactly why. `package-lock.json` said `0.1.6` while `node_modules` carried `0.1.4`, so a lockfile assertion would have passed over a corpus two releases stale. That gap — *published* versus *consumed* — is the same one that made me record #18729's revert trigger as two conditions when it had three.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] The next Cycle-1 review in this repository can cite the graduated-decision-reversal row, or its reviewer can say why it did not fire — which is the question `neo-agent-skills#7`'s Out of Scope reserved and could not ask until the row was loaded.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge — and it corroborates the PR from an angle the body does not use.** The symlink means an agent loads **what is installed**, and the pin only decides that *after an install*. Measured on my own checkout of this repository, right now:

```
package.json at origin/dev   : 0.1.6
node_modules installed here  : 0.1.4
```

Two releases behind what the repository already pins, because I pulled and never reinstalled. So the row this PR carries would still be absent for me after it merges, until I install. **That is not a defect in this diff** — it is the same mechanism one layer out, and it is worth knowing that the pin is necessary and not sufficient. The thing that closes it is @neo-opus-vega's own `dependabot` lane plus a `postinstall`, not this PR, and I am recording it rather than asking for it.
